players.bio: Andreas Seidl (born 6 January 1976) is a German motorsport engineer and manager. He was previously the chief executive officer of Sauber Motorsport, the team principal of McLaren and the team principal of the hybrid Porsche LMP1 program. Career Seidl graduated from the Technical University of Munich with a diploma in mechanical engineering. Seidl worked in F1 for BMW between 2000 and 2009.

Lando Norris (born 13 November 1999) is a British racing driver currently competing in Formula 1 for McLaren. He won the MSA Formula championship in 2015, and the Toyota Racing Series, Eurocup Formula Renault 2.0 and Formula Renault 2.0 Northern European Cup in 2016. He also received the McLaren Autosport BRDC Award that year. He subsequently won the 2017 FIA Formula 3 European Championship.

Oscar Piastri (born 6 April 2001 in Melbourne) is an Australian racing driver, member of the Renault Sport Academy and reigning Formula Renault Eurocup champion. He will compete in the 2020 FIA Formula 2 Championship for Prema alongside Frederik Vesti and Logan Sargeant. Piastri is due to be the reserve driver for the Alpine F1 Team for the 2022 Formula One Championship.
